No launching-user token forwarding was found. AWS uses workload credentials and eligibility exchanges the projected workload token. Payments, SMS and EHR use per-clinic stored provider credentials, but their issuance and whether they are shared are absent. The model client's credential provisioning is also absent. Reading secrets through agent IAM does not establish the provider principal's exclusivity.

AWS grants bind to the runtime role, but EHR access continues through cached OAuth bearer tokens and existing authenticated sessions without another IAM/Secrets Manager check. Removing the runtime binding alone therefore does not cut already-issued EHR access; provider-side revocation or expiry is additionally needed. No mechanism coupling provider-token revocation to the workload principal is defined here.
